doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Partial Revision of Matters Pertaining to Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Expansion of Acquisition Frame)
doc_title_jp: 自己株式取得に係る事項の一部変更（取得枠の拡大）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.method: Market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange
key_facts.reason_jp: 資本効率の向上および株主還元の充実を図り、更なる経営環境の変化に対応した機動的な資本政策を遂行するため

summary_en: LEC expanded its share buyback authorization by 100% to 2 million shares (6.1% of outstanding shares) and 2 billion yen, extending the acquisition period to February 26, 2027. As of October 31, 2026, the company had acquired 869,500 shares for 828 million yen under the previous 1 billion yen frame.
summary_jp: レックが自己株式取得枠を200万株・20億円に拡大した。発行済株式数に対する割合は6.1％。取得期間を2027年2月26日まで延長。10月31日時点で前回枠から869,500株を828百万円で取得済み。
tag_jp: 自己株式取得枠の拡大

doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (30th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
doc_title_jp: 通期業績予想及び配当予想（上場30周年記念配当）の修正に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 上場30周年を記念し株主への感謝の意を表す。一方、円安進行、中東紛争に伴う原燃料価格上昇、AI搭載ぬいぐるみ関連研究開発費増加により利益予想を下方修正。

summary_en: LEC revised FY2027 dividend guidance to 38 yen per share, adding a 10 yen commemorative dividend at fiscal year-end to mark its 30th anniversary of listing. Full-year dividend comprises 14 yen interim and 24 yen year-end (14 yen ordinary plus 10 yen commemorative). Net income forecast was lowered due to yen weakness, rising raw material costs, and increased R&D spending.
summary_jp: 2027年3月期の年間配当予想を38円に修正し、上場30周年を記念して期末配当に10円の記念配当を追加。中間配当14円、期末配当24円（普通配当14円＋記念配当10円）で構成。円安、原燃料価格上昇、AI製品開発費増加により純利益予想を下方修正。
tag_en: Dividend Policy Update with 30th Anniversary Commemoration
tag_jp: 配当予想修正（上場30周年記念配当）

summary_en: 1,000,000 shares (2.97% of shares outstanding) authorized for acquisition up to ¥1,000M via open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange; execution window Jun 9 – Dec 8, 2026. Stated reason: improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder returns.
